steps.title: GitHub remotes
steps.detail: Each project (and profile) keeps a portfolio/ folder with project.md plus optional architecture.json and preview image; listed in sync.config.ts.

steps.title: Sync script
steps.detail: bun run sync pulls known files into live src/content/projects|profile and writes git-meta.json from semver tags (fail-closed on bad remotes).

steps.title: Collections
steps.detail: Astro Content Collection loaders assemble typed Project/Profile domain objects; pages read only through src/content/adapter.ts.

steps.title: Astro pages
steps.detail: SSG routes render the shell; React islands handle filters, search, and architecture diagrams over Tailwind/Starwind/shadcn UI.

steps.title: GitHub Pages
steps.detail: CI deploy syncs then builds static output to Pages with ASTRO_SITE/ASTRO_BASE and a token for private content remotes.
